neighbours.label: capitalised verb used as part of a title or name after a brand or organisation ('Comics Presents', 'Soundcrash Presents', 'County Tax Collectors')
fire: Tonight the venue hosts Bassline Records Presents: a night of deep house.
The flyer read Marvel Comics Presents the Avengers in bold red letters.
Tickets are on sale for Riverside Arts Presents an Evening of Jazz.
Next week the local theatre group Starlight Presents a new comedy.
The old cover of Disney Presents Winnie the Pooh is now rare.
Join us at the library for Author Talks Presents a children's reading.
The festival poster announced Echo Sound Presents DJ Marlow live.
Last spring the network aired National Geographic Presents Wild Alaska.
